core_memory.user_introduction_michael: Michael, 35, lives in Seattle, freelance graphic designer, values design aesthetics in gadgets, interested in high-quality coffee machines to enhance his morning routine.
core_memory.user_preference_espresso: Michael prefers espresso machines with sleek, modern designs, especially stainless-steel finishes. He seeks a café-like experience without needing professional barista skills, emphasizing ease of use, smart features, and aesthetic appeal.
core_memory.user_inquiry_pricing: Michael is a first-time buyer looking for pricing details on espresso machines, specifically interested in any new customer discounts, promotional offers, or bundle deals. He saw a 'New Customer Discount' on the homepage but didn't click it in time.
core_memory.user_shipping_inquiry: Michael is in Seattle and is concerned about shipping times, especially due to rainy weather. He wants to know if products are shipped from a local warehouse, and if so, what the expected delivery time is—particularly since he's hosting a family gathering later this month.
core_memory.user_temperature_inquiry: Michael is concerned about coffee temperature consistency and has had issues with drip machines that don't heat sufficiently, leading him to microwave his coffee. He wants to know if your espresso machines offer adjustable temperature settings or reliably hot coffee.
